description: Elecatro v1 is an AI co-founder that remembers every decision you've made, builds context over time, and helps you think through what comes next — based on your history, not generic advice. Join the private-beta waitlist.

name: Déjà View
tagline: See who already tried your idea, and why they died
description: Describe your idea in one line. Déjà View digs up the companies that tried it before you: when they launched, when they died, what killed them, and who survived. Every finding sourced. Read the obituaries before you write the pitch.

name: Drivn
tagline: Know your best next moves for your startup
description: Stop guessing how to grow your startup. Generate the 3 highest-impact moves aligned to your startup’s strategy. Cut noise. Execute what actually drives growth.

name: Founder Validation OS
tagline: Validate startup ideas & AI-power your customer discovery
description: Validate Your Startup Idea Before Writing a Single Line of Code Most startups don't fail because they can't build the product—they fail because they built something nobody wanted. Founder Validation OS is a complete Notion workspace equipped with 6 integrated databases and 9 custom AI prompts designed to walk you through customer discovery, risk scoring, competitor research, and pitch building so you can build with the confidence of knowing you will create real impact.

name: Ledger & Lore
tagline: A free, sourced archive of 192 startup failures
description: Most startup-failure content is either a listicle repeating the same 10 examples (Theranos, FTX, Quibi), or bundled into expensive tools like Crunchbase that treat failure as a footnote. Ledger & Lore is different: 192 companies, each pairing real funding data with a sourced explanation of what went wrong and a plain lesson, not just a "closed" tag. Undisclosed figures are marked, never guessed. Compare any two companies side by side, or filter by industry, country, or cause.

name: ReverseYC
tagline: See what startups built after YC said no
description: ReverseYC is a public record of startups that applied to Y Combinator, were rejected, and kept building. Explore evidence-backed funding, revenue, and user milestones, or submit your own story. Rejections are self-reported. Not affiliated with YC.

name: GhostCTO
tagline: AI-powered product planning for non-technical founders
description: GhostCTO helps founders turn messy ideas into clear technical plans. Instead of spending weeks figuring out features, architecture, timelines, and what to tell developers, GhostCTO asks the right questions and generates practical documents you can actually build from. Whether you're hiring an agency, working with freelancers, or building your first MVP, you'll know exactly what needs to be built before writing a single line of code.
topics: Hiring, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Startup Lessons

name: Eurematic
tagline: From idea to running business in one place
description: Launch your startup faster with AI. Validate ideas, generate investor-ready business documents, create a professional startup website, plan your MVP, and market your business—all in one platform.

name: Negeinno
tagline: Discover startups, creators, opportunities, and innovation
description: Negeinno is a platform where founders, creators, startups, innovators, and professionals can discover opportunities, showcase their work, share ideas, and connect with a growing community. Explore Orbit for community updates, Eureka for innovative ideas, startup and brand showcases, blogs, and business opportunities—all in one ecosystem designed to help people build, collaborate, and grow.

name: Complete Presentation & Pitch Deck Tool
tagline: AI slide outlines, speaker notes, and pitch deck structure
description: PitchCraft AI solves the blank-slide problem. Describe your topic and get a full slide-by-slide outline, natural speaker notes, an investor-ready pitch deck structure, or a strong opening hook. What stands out: it's browser-only, no account needed, and focused entirely on structure and content — the part that actually determines whether a presentation lands, not just visual design. One-time $14.99, no subscription. Powered by Claude AI.

name: ChangeXStartup
tagline: Build. Connect. Scale.
description: Find co-founders, jobs, campaigns, and join the next wave of breakout Indian startups on ChangeXStartup.

name: Banalytics
tagline: Self-hosted VMS for cameras, sensors & IoT
description: Hybrid edge platform: an open-source Java agent that turns cameras, sensors, and physical systems into one automated setup, paired with a hosted portal for remote access over WebRTC. Speaks ONVIF/RTSP, Modbus, MQTT; detects with YOLO or Gemini AI. Video and sensor data stay on your hardware - the portal only handles connection and billing. Free Community plan. An alternative to Frigate, Blue Iris, and Shinobi.
topics: Hardware, Internet of Things, Home Automation

name: HomeDeck
tagline: Your HomeKit dashboard on Apple TV
description: HomeDeck turns Apple TV into a full-screen dashboard for Apple Home. Browse rooms, devices, scenes, sensors, climate information, security systems, and compatible cameras from the sofa. After inactivity, HomeDeck switches to Ambient Mode. HomeDeck is now live on the App Store for Apple TV and iPad. The TestFlight beta has ended, and the release version is available to buy and install.

name: Maestro Snap
tagline: Point at a lamp, snap your fingers, it turns on
description: Point your arm at a lamp, like you're showing it to a friend, and snap your fingers. It turns on. Maestro Snap teaches your Apple Watch where your things are. You "paint" each device once by sweeping your arm at it, and from then on the watch knows what you're aiming at. It learns from your corrections, so it gets better with use. No cameras, no hubs, no cloud. Works with Apple Home and Home Assistant. Free for one device, $8.99 one-time for the house.

name: Dtap V1.0
tagline: Hands-on automation training. No hardware required.
description: A twin to learn reality. Train on real industrial automation scenarios using DTAP — the Digital Twin Automation Process Simulator. 10-day free trial. Windows & macOS.

name: Call Box Helper
tagline: Your Gate Opens Itself
description: Call Box Helper automatically answers your call box, sends the unlock tone, and hangs up. So your gate opens without you touching your phone.

name: Teya
tagline: An AI agent for home, running on a wall‑mounted Android.
description: Teya is an open‑source AI family agent on a wall‑mounted Android phone. Multi‑user: recognizes speakers, keeps per‑person memory, “dreams” nightly to consolidate/forget. No backend: data, memory, wake word, VAD, voice ID run on‑device; cloud only for LLM, STT, TTS via Mistral (your key). Native Kotlin using Android telephony/calendar/alarms; calls are plain cellular, never joined. A private, extendable household “second brain”.
topics: Open Source, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Home Automation

name: cctvQL
tagline: Ask your cameras anything in plain English
description: cctvQL is an open source conversational query layer for CCTV systems. Ask questions like "Were there any people at the front door last night?" and get real answers from Frigate, Hikvision, Synology, Dahua, ONVIF cameras, and more. Works with local LLMs (Ollama) or cloud (OpenAI, Claude). Integrates with Home Assistant and ioBroker. Supports face recognition, push notifications, and multi-camera setups. 100% open source, self-hosted, privacy-first.
topics: Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Home Automation

name: Cozyla 15.6" Calendar Neo
tagline: A Smart family calendar created for simple everyday life.
description: Meet Cozyla Calendar Neo, an AI-powered digital family hub that keeps your schedules, meals, routines, and tasks organized in one shared space. With 5-minute setup, automatic iCloud/Google/Outlook calendar sync, hands-free AI voice support, chore and reward tracking, meal planning with a recipe library, and customizable photo & video screensavers, Cozyla makes everyday family organization simpler and more connected.

name: MyTesla.io - Tesla MCP
tagline: Connect your Tesla to your AI assistant.
description: Tesla MCP server that connects your car to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any AI assistant. Plain-English requests turn into real commands — composed with your calendar, weather, and the rest of your day.
topics: Artificial Intelligence, Home Automation, Electric Cars

name: SayChef
tagline: Speak your recipes. AI manages your kitchen
description: SayChef is the first voice-first recipe app designed to preserve your culinary legacy. Stop losing family recipes on scraps of paper or messy notes—simply talk your recipes into existence. SayChef uses AI to instantly capture, structure, and organize your cooking history, making it perfectly searchable and easy to share. From Grandma's secret sauce to your own daily meal prep, digitize your kitchen in seconds using only your voice. SayChef: Capture the moment, savor the recipe.

name: Nexop
tagline: Smart home AI that learns your routines and automates them
description: Most hubs wait for you to write the rules. Nexop watches how your home actually runs for a week, then proposes automations you approve, edit or ignore. Everything runs on the box. Simple commands land in ~0.3s without calling the model at all. Describe an automation in plain English — "every weekday at 7pm", "when there's no motion for 5 minutes" — and it's written and live in seconds. Native Zigbee, KNX, Matter and WiFi. One-time purchase. No subscription, no cloud.

name: Unabyss for Claude
tagline: Shared memory across all apps and LLMs. In Claude
description: Claude doesn't know what happens in GPT. Neither one really knows who you are or what your company does. Now they can. Unabyss gives Claude memories from your other AI agents and everyday apps: email, Drive, GitHub, Notion, meeting recorders, and 20+ more. It saves new memories too, so GPT and Cursor stay in sync with the exact same context - sharper than wiring each tool into Claude one by one. Finally, a real memory that follows you. Private. Portable.

name: Velo 3.0
tagline: AI video infrastructure to explain, train, and sell faster.
description: Velo 3.0 is here, our third and biggest launch yet. Start with a screen recording or a prompt. Describe the video you need, and Velo writes the script, narrates it in your own voice, and builds the finished cut. It stays grounded in your company knowledge, from your docs and tools you connect through connectors and MCP. Edit by typing changes. Localize the finished video into 25+ languages in one click. Recording or prompt, Velo turns either into a polished video you can ship anywhere.

name: SKI
tagline: Free voice coding for Claude Code, Codex and more
description: We just built SKI — voice coding for Claude Code, Codex and more. It's not dictation: your agent answers you out loud, like a real teammate, so you build at the speed you think. You can even bring it into a meeting to build live, or send it in your place to speak for you. It's an ambient thing that just sits on your desktop — hit a key, talk, it works. All on your machine, free. Available on Mac & Windows.

name: Hey Noah
tagline: A proactive AI executive assistant for founders
description: Noah is a proactive AI executive assistant for founders. Claude talks to you; Noah talks to your network. It's like Tesla Full Self Driving, and not cruise control- an autonomous AI EA that manages your calendar, relationships, and follow-ups across email, text, and WhatsApp - so nothing slips. Think of it as an always-on EA living in your SMS and helping you with meeting logistics.

name: Memmy Agent
tagline: Let every AI remember the same you.
description: 🍙 Memmy Agent is a personal memory hub and local AI agent for all AI Agent and tools like Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw and Hermes. Gives every AI one shared, full-controlled memory — they all remember the same you. Memmy turns chats, decisions, prefs, progresses, and experiences into long-term memory, brings the right context into matching task, also can take on work directly. Local-first by default. Your memory stay under your control: manage them anytime. Free start with 2M ChatGPT tokens.

name: Grok Bot
tagline: AI teammates that you can give real work to
description: Introducing Grok Bot: AI teammates you can give real work to. Bots sign into your tools, use them like you do, and come back with finished work. Message them like a teammate. They keep context, multitask, and learn your working style on their own cloud computer. Ask Bots to run outbound overnight, code expenses from Gmail, schedule a recruiting onsite, rebalance paid ads, or ship a bug pack. They only come back when something needs your approval.

name: Soloop
tagline: Approval-first Agent OS for solo founders
description: Soloop is an agentic company-building system for solo founders. It takes you from idea to revenue with an AI CEO to plan, manage and prioritize, an AI CTO to build and execute, and an AI CMO to find users and sell. Keep your own judgment and ownership while delegating the unfamiliar work that usually requires a team.

name: Nautis
tagline: The AI-native Operating System for founders.
description: Nautis is the AI-native Operating System for founders. Manage fundraising, planning, finance, documents, meetings, CRM, hiring, and daily operations from one connected workspace. Unlike disconnected SaaS tools, every module shares one AI brain, giving you context-aware automation, smarter insights, and a Chief of Staff that understands your business—not just one app. Spend less time managing tools and more time building.

name: Artifacts by Databox
tagline: Ask your AI Analyst and get back a ready-to-share report
description: Turn any conversation with your AI Analyst into a polished report, slide deck, or interactive document built from your live data. Generate it from a single prompt, then share it via public link or download as a PDF.

name: Teable 3.0
tagline: AI Spreadsheet for Business
description: Turn your business data into AI workflows and custom apps. Connect any system, migrate any data, and build anything that fits your business 100%.
topics: Productivity, Spreadsheets, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, OpenAI Day

name: PromptQL
tagline: Multiplayer AI that replaces Slack
description: Stop splitting team knowledge between Slack and everyone's private AI chats. PromptQL is multiplayer AI for teams: think Claude or ChatGPT in shared threads. Tag teammates to review, correct, and refine answers without losing the reasoning. Connect databases, SaaS apps, coding agents, and events. PromptQL captures tribal knowledge and suggests shared-brain updates so context compounds. Scopes and multi-user permissions keep the right context accessible to the right people.
topics: Productivity, SaaS, Artificial Intelligence, OpenAI Day

name: Omniwork
tagline: The Creative Agent OS, create better with desktop AI agents
description: Omniwork is an always-on Creative Agent OS that turns ideas into finished work. Specialized AI agents research, create, monitor, and automate your creative workflows, while a proactive desktop companion keeps projects moving and pushes results, alerts, and progress straight to your screen.
topics: Productivity, Artificial Intelligence, Social media marketing

name: Zinley
tagline: Your Personal AI Representative for calls, email, and tasks
description: Most AI waits inside a chat. Zinley is reachable by you and the people around you. With its own phone number and email, it answers calls, handles email, books things, and gets work done within your rules. It remembers your people and relationships, then reports back in your language. Not another chatbot. A second you that shows up.

name: TouchGrass
tagline: Context-aware break reminders without invasive permissions
description: TouchGrass is a context-aware break reminder built for macOS. Most break reminders only know one thing: time. TouchGrass waits through meetings, calls, media playback and screen recordings, counts time away from your Mac as a completed break, and reminds you to blink, improve your posture and rest after long typing sessions. Everything runs locally, never asks for Accessibility permission, and respects your workflow. 7 day free trial, then a one time purchase of $3.99 with lifetime updates.
topics: Health & Fitness, Productivity, Menu Bar Apps

name: Spycost
tagline: Fell for a discount again?
description: Remember the last time you bought something at a discount, only to see it later for the same price without the discount? Or when the product costs more today than it did yesterday. Did you feel cheated? Are you ready to look behind the screen of manipulation and lies? Spycost helps you see when you’re paying more while thinking you’re paying less. It gives you the full price picture, so you can decide whether it’s actually worth it.

name: Agently
tagline: Your whole stack, running itself!
description: Every other tool answers, retrieves, or runs brittle rules. Agently holds your whole company in context and does the work. 100+ connectors flow into one brain that never forgets. It links a Stripe event to a Slack thread to a Linear ticket on its own. When something needs doing, Jarvis routes it to an agent that runs it end to end: triggered, running, shipped. The work lands without you, nothing falls through the cracks. Connecting takes minutes. The layer between today's AI and tomorrow's AGI.

name: Pushary
tagline: Approve AI requests from your lock screen
description: One command connects your AI agents to your lock screen. When Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Hermes, or Claude Cowork stops to ask, you tap yes from your phone and the run keeps moving. New in this launch: native iPhone and Android apps. Pairing is a QR code you scan from the terminal, no key to paste. Per-tool policies auto-approve the safe reads. Every decision lands in an audit trail.

name: Wondering
tagline: Duolingo for learning anything
description: Wondering is the most delightful way to break down complex topics into knowledge you can remember and apply. Tell it what you want to learn, and it creates a personalized path of short lessons with visuals, podcasts, and interactive exercises. It surfaces the most important ideas and lets you explore them in your own way, like a thoughtful tutor beside you.

name: Campus
tagline: One project space for humans and AI agents
description: Campus gives builders a shared space to build with teammates and AI agents. Keep your repo, terminal, project knowledge, conversations, and agent work together in one persistent workspace, instead of scattering context across Slack threads, docs, tickets, canvases, and one-off AI chats. Campus is organized around the thing you are building, so humans and agents can pick up where the work left off.

name: VoiceOS App Store
tagline: The app store for voice native apps that lives in your notch
description: The App Store for your voice, where building takes one sentence. Describe what you want "Create an app to help me to journal" and VoiceOS creates the app for you. Share it as a link and anyone can install it in a click.

name: Migma AI
tagline: AI runs your email marketing. Better with every send.
description: Migma creates full campaigns before you ask. It understands your goals and events, creates every email, personalizes and localizes it, and renders consistently across inboxes. It handles sending, preferences and compliance, then learns what drives revenue.

name: NudgeForMe
tagline: AI follow-up agent for missed email opportunities
description: NudgeForMe scans your sent conversations, finds threads where someone never replied, and drafts natural follow-ups inside your own mailbox. It starts in draft mode, so you stay in control. You can review each opportunity, select the useful ones, and send from Gmail, Outlook, or IMAP/SMTP. Built by the Snoooz team after processing millions of emails, NudgeForMe is focused on one painful workflow: making sure leads, deals, partnerships, and customer conversations do not quietly go cold.

name: Timely
tagline: Pull your calendar availability in 3 seconds
description: Pull your availability from connected calendars, with a single keystroke, within whichever timezone suits your recipient best. No opening the calendar, no timezone maths, and it handles multiple execs too. It's completely private and sits locally on your machine, connecting only to Outlook and Google.

name: PureBox.ai
tagline: Review-first AI cleanup for your real Gmail inbox.
description: Most inbox tools make you build rules first. PureBox skips that - it's personalized from your first scan using AI and your own Gmail history (which senders you open, reply to, or let pile up), so suggestions fit your routine on day one. Every suggestion shows why, and nothing moves until you approve - no black box, no silent deletions. It surfaces what needs your attention, not just what to trash. Your data is never sold; Pro subscriptions fund it.

name: Customer.io Summer Release
tagline: New ways to reach customers in the moments that matter
description: Customer.io's most expansive launch yet brings powerful new ways to engage customers exactly when it matters across expanded triggers, surfaces, and channels. Reach customers with geofencing, Live Notifications, flexible SMS providers, notification inbox, and beyond. Improved WhatsApp management, smarter AI, and more, all from one platform.

name: Skim
tagline: Free, open-source AI email client for Windows
description: Skim is a free, open-source (MIT) email client for Windows. ✂️ Minimal on purpose: no calendar, no rules engine, no bloat. Fewer buttons, less cognitive load. ⚡ Native Rust core (Tauri 2): ~5 MB installer, sub-second cold start, instant full-text search. 🔒 Local-first, offline-ready, zero telemetry. ✦ AI on your terms: bring your own Anthropic or OpenRouter key and Skim drafts replies in your voice and answers questions across your whole mailbox.

name: Memo
tagline: Turn one idea into an email worth remembering.
description: Most email tools help you send. Memo helps you matter.

name: GreenmorMail
tagline: One inbox. Outreach, team chat, AI, and video — built in.
description: Business email hosting at $1/mailbox/month — with outreach sequences, in-thread team chat, video conferencing, an AI assistant, Drive, and Calendar built in. No ads. No data mining. Powered by AWS SES. Set up in under 10 minutes.

name: ForthWrite
tagline: AI email writer that actually sounds like you.
description: ForthWrite drafts replies in your voice inside Gmail, Outlook, and LinkedIn. Every edit becomes a training signal, so drafts get closer to how you write over time. Standouts: closed-loop voice matching, a visible improvement curve, ability to hit "Generate draft" in any thread, plus Pro auto-draft, batch, and Prompt Lab. BYOK on paid plans (9 providers). Free: 10 drafts/week, no card, no API key. 14-day Pro trial included.
topics: Chrome Extensions, Email, Productivity, Artificial Intelligence

name: Email Finder by Truelist
tagline: Find anyone's work email — verified, not guessed
description: Enter a name and a company domain, get back a verified work email — checked against live mail servers, not guessed from name patterns. Free, no signup, no credits. Built by Truelist, the email validation platform behind 1B+ verified emails.

name: Engine Mail
tagline: Private AI email with security, control, and MCP built in
description: Engine Mail is a private, AI-powered email workspace for every inbox. Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo or any IMAP email account in one unified inbox. Run AI locally or with your own key to summarize threads, extract tasks, search naturally and write better replies. Block trackers, detect phishing, deep-scan suspicious links and attachments, screen unknown senders, unsubscribe in one click, automate cleanup, work offline, track real engagement and collaborate securely.

name: Postfleet
tagline: Prompt-injection-safe email for AI agents
description: AI agents are getting email but raw inboxes are an attack surface: prompt injection, spam, malicious files. Postfleet is email infrastructure for agents. Every inbound message is verified, spam/virus-screened, and checked for prompt injection before your agent reads it, then delivered already parsed and comprehended. Outbound is idempotent with optional human approval. 6 MCP tools + a REST API. Would love your feedback!

name: GhostRelay
tagline: Free, self-hosted email aliasing. No server. No month bill.
description: GhostRelay generates unlimited masked email addresses on Cloudflare's free tier. Give every service a unique alias — when one gets compromised, kill it instantly. • Unlimited aliases, zero cost • Per-alias stats & expiring aliases • Reply anonymously from any alias • Self-host in 15 minutes, no server needed Open source (MIT). No Docker. No VPS. No monthly bill. Just deploy and own your email privacy forever.

name: Agent07
tagline: Sales Agents - makes sales 2x faster
description: Agent07 is an agentic sales platform for lean teams. AI agents handle email, meetings, docs and CRM updates automatically, so reps spend time selling. Every rep gets following super powers: - An Executive Assistant responding to your emails. - Meeting recording, summary - Scheduling assistant - Sent email analytics - Vault as second memory - Agents to create custom decks or invoices - Auto-updating CRM and more. Onboarding: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z19JY0qIZnw

name: Magic Dragin
tagline: Drag files from email and cloud apps into any Windows app
description: Magic Dragin restores the drag-and-drop workflow that modern Windows apps broke. Drag emails, attachments, and cloud files from new Outlook, Outlook on the web, Gmail, Teams, Slack, OneDrive, SharePoint, and more directly into any Windows app or web page. No more saving to Downloads, finding the file, and uploading it again.

name: LeadIQX
tagline: AI-powered B2B lead generation platform
description: Premium, verifiable business leads on demand real phones, emails, addresses, and ratings, enriched and ready to export. Pay only per verified lead.

name: QuickPing
tagline: Every customer message, in one quiet inbox.
description: Share one link. People message you. You reply, they get an email. No widgets, no tickets, no clutter.

name: Pesterly
tagline: Automated client document collection that follows up for you
description: Pesterly is a document collection tool for Google Workspace that turns a checklist of files into an email request, chases whatever is still missing on a fixed schedule, and saves every upload into a folder in your own Google Drive.

name: Dead Man Send
tagline: Never let an important message go unsent
description: Dead Man Send automatically sends your emails if you stop checking in. Set a timer, compose your messages, and we'll deliver them if you don't check in. Free plan available.

name: Superunit
tagline: AI agents that verify employment by phone, email & fax
description: Every time someone gets hired, applies for a mortgage, or leases an apartment, someone has to confirm they actually worked where they said they did. That means millions of calls, emails, faxes (yes, in 2026), to HR and payroll departments. Superunit's AI agents do all of that from start to finish. They research, call, email, fax and handle documents until the verification is done.

name: JustInterview.ai
tagline: Hire 20× Faster. Fill Roles in Days, Not Weeks
description: On JustInterview.ai you can evaluate candidates through AI Interviews, Coding Assessments, MCQ Tests, Vibe Coding Challenges, and role-specific skill evaluations, while automating every stage of recruitment. Create job descriptions, screen resumes instantly, manage campus drives, collaborate with hiring teams, generate offer letters, and make faster, data-driven hiring decisions from one unified platform. Our vision is simple: if there's an interview, it should happen on JustInterview.ai.

name: SiftFirst
tagline: Stop drowning in AI resumes, start hiring the right people
description: Small businesses now get 200+ applications per role, most AI-generated. SiftFirst ranks candidates against your criteria and quotes the evidence for every score. No signup required to try. You set the rubric, you make the call, you see the reasoning. New this month: an Ask tab to chat with your shortlist, team sharing with interview review, AI-prefilled interview scorecards, and pool analytics.

name: EmpikaAI
tagline: Ai resume screening
description: Ai resume screening and data collection using ai work flow that screen resumes and send notifications to users automatically or manually

name: Hireable
tagline: Job search while you sleep.
description: Most career tools give advice and leave people to it. Hireable does the work, a Career Concierge that builds and tailors your CV to every role, rehearses your interviews with honest feedback, finds roles that genuinely fit and applies on your behalf - learning what works as it goes. We take the stress out of job search.

name: Recrutador
tagline: Simple ATS for SMBs with realtime interview assistance
description: Most ATS are built for big companies with HR teams. So small businesses interview off a googled question list and a spreadsheet, then decide on gut. Recrutador is made for them: it helps at every step of the hiring process, defining evaluation criteria, triaging resumes, and assists you live during the interview. No HR team. No subscription. No hassle.

name: EvenShift
tagline: Fair staff schedules that can't play favorites
description: Most staff schedulers (7shifts, Homebase, Deputy) optimize the owner's labor cost. EvenShift optimizes fairness to the worker and proves it: never schedules anyone over a requested day off, a plain-language reason on every shift, and a visible fairness score every week. For restaurants, bars, cafés, salons & spas. Bilingual EN + Quebec French, one-tap phone calendar sync. 7-day free trial, no card.

name: Ziggers
tagline: India's marketplace for flexible local work.
description: Ziggers is India's on-demand gig marketplace for hiring catering staff, event workers, delivery partners, warehouse workers, hospitality staff, and finding part-time, temporary, flexible, and daily wage jobs across India.

name: Attenditai
tagline: The Modern Standard for Attendance Tracking
description: Attenditai is a comprehensive attendance tracking and check-in software designed for various industries including education, healthcare, and events. It offers features like QR code scanning, geofencing, and kiosk mode to ensure accurate and audit-ready attendance records. Users can import rosters, capture signatures, and export data seamlessly, making it ideal for organizations needing reliable attendance verification.

name: No Bad Hire
tagline: Check if a candidate truly fits your company culture
description: Most hiring tools evaluate a candidate's CV or skills. No Bad Hire checks whether a candidate actually fits your company's culture. First, your team completes a short survey that maps your real culture (not the aspirational one). Then candidates take a psychometric assessment. The tool compares both and generates a fit report: strengths, potential challenges, and what they'll add to your team. Built on validated psychometric models. Free plan available, no card required.

name: Heimdal by Bearlog
tagline: Turn your device into a face recognition time clock
description: Heimdal turns any device with a camera and a browser into an attendance kiosk. Staff tap IN or OUT, look at the screen, and the record lands in seconds. No fingerprint terminal to buy, no ID cards to reissue, nothing to install. People enroll from their own phone with a group invite link. The kiosk runs a liveness check, converts the face to a template on the device, and sends no photo after enrollment. Attendance, monthly summaries and CSV exports are built in.

name: Critical Mass Cloud
tagline: HR + Accounting + e-Sign for S$29/mo — not per employee
description: Singapore-native HR, Accounting, and e-Signatures in one app. Payroll with full CPF/SDL/IRAS compliance, double-entry accounting with GST 9% and InvoiceNow e-invoicing, plus DocuSign-style document signing — all behind one login. Flat pricing: S$29/mo for all three modules, not S$5/employee. A 30-employee company pays S$29, not S$214. Your headcount grows, your bill doesn't. 14-day free trial, no card required.

name: ATS Engine: Intelligent Hiring
tagline: AI applicant tracking with intelligent candidate matching
description: ATS Engine is an AI-powered recruitment platform built for recruiters, employers and job seekers. Automate CV parsing, candidate matching, applicant tracking, interview scheduling and hiring workflows with Jobster, your AI recruitment assistant. Recruit faster, reduce admin, improve hiring decisions and deliver a better candidate experience—all from one intelligent platform.

name: Beehive HRMS
tagline: Best HRMS to Manage Payroll, Attendance & Employee Data
description: Streamline your HR operations with our powerful HRMS software. Manage payroll, attendance, employee data, and performance efficiently. Boost productivity and simplify HR processes today!

name: Hiring Method
tagline: Deterministic, math-driven recruitment platform.
description: Hiring Method converts subjective resumes and job requirements into an objective, dynamic scorecard. We use a transparent math engine to continuously rank your talent pool, so you always know exactly who fits best and why.

name: HRmonium
tagline: HR, payroll, and people operations—working in harmony.
description: HRmonium is an all-in-one HRIS and Canadian payroll platform built for small and growing businesses. Manage employees, payroll calculations, timesheets, time off, benefits, documents, tax profiles, paystubs, T4s, and more from one simple system—without needing a technical or accounting background.

name: RoleSage
tagline: See the person in an avalanche of AI-polished applications
description: AI-polished applications make genuine capability harder than ever for hiring teams to identify - and for strong candidates to make visible. RoleSage gives candidates editable, evidence-backed profiles linked to real activities, skills, and outcomes. Smaller hiring teams inspect explainable match bands, supporting evidence, gaps, and interview questions inside a light ATS. AI helps organise context; people remain responsible for the decision.

name: PlanProvider.Pro
tagline: Retirement plan intelligence for humans and AI agents
description: Search retirement plans by sponsor, industry, service provider, balances, contributions, and growth metrics using Department of Labor Form 5500 data.Search 140,000+ employer retirement plans, explore Form 5500 filings, compare providers and benchmarks, or bring sourced retirement plan intelligence into Claude, Codex and other MCP-compatible AI tools.

name: ResumeRadar  — Your AI Hiring Bestie
tagline: Screen 1000 resumes in one coffee break. No cap.
description: Tired of scrolling through 200 resumes at 11pm? ResumeRadar's got you. Our AI screens, scores, and ranks candidates in minutes — and even catches the hidden gems your ATS keeps filtering out. Toss in an AI Interview Copilot so you're never stuck on what to ask, and you've basically got a recruiter bestie who works 24/7 and never complains. Upload. Screen. Hire. It's giving efficient. 🎯

name: Scout Mesh
tagline: Sourcing databases inside Claude, pay per query
description: Turn Claude or ChatGPT into a sourcing machine: one MCP gateway to Apollo, People Data Labs, Lusha, ContactOut, GitHub and more. No markup — pay only provider costs.

name: Rechroma
tagline: Build better color palettes. Ship complete color systems.
description: Rechroma is a workspace for exploring color, shaping palettes, and building complete color systems for products, brands, interfaces, and more. Start with a color or image, explore recommendations in Oklch, preview your palette, and export to Figma or code.
topics: Design Tools, Branding, Design resources, OpenAI Day

name: Asset Organizer
tagline: Extract, deduplicate, organize every asset from figma file.
description: Asset Organizer scans your Figma selection and pulls out every icon, image, illustration, and logo — collapsing duplicates, grouping by category, and cleaning up layer names for dev handoff. Run it again after adding new screens and it only shows what's new. Free, no account, entirely inside Figma.
topics: User Experience, UX Design, Design resources

name: designdex.org
tagline: Turn research into evidence based design decisions
description: DesignDex is a design research platform built for students, designers, and innovators. Discover credible research papers, academic studies, and evidence across product design, engineering, psychology, ergonomics, sustainability, materials, technology, and more. Search or explore multidisciplinary research, find unexpected insights, and build better design projects backed by real evidence, not AI-generated citations.

name: Whorl
tagline: A generative design tool. No AI. Lots of play.
description: Generative design tool for mesmerizing visuals, still and in motion. Posters for events, brand and presentation assets, music-video loops, conference identities, etc. All from play: make something unique in seconds, or spend hours creating. Runs in your browser on desktop or tablet.
topics: Design Tools, Graphics & Design, Design resources

name: Fontalog
tagline: The world's biggest font database
description: Fontalog is a searchable, super-fast, free database of fonts, created by FontBase, built on Redis and Cloudflare workers. You can search fonts by visual characteristics like proportion, contrast, weight and xHeight. On every font page there are multiple similar fonts displayed along with foundry info and exact parameter numbers, which you can use to search even more fonts.

name: Motoko UI
tagline: Beautiful React components you own. Built for production.
description: Everything you need to build modern React applications. Components, docs, a Motoko UI is an open-source collection of polished React components, blocks, and patterns for modern apps. Built on the shadcn/ui model — you copy the code, own every line, and customize without fighting a black-box library. Every component is crafted with intentional spacing, typography, motion, and accessibility (Radix UI). Works with React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript.
topics: Open Source, Software Engineering, GitHub, Design resources

name: Morquick Website Inspiration & Resources
tagline: Find design inspiration and resources
description: Morquick is a popular online platform that provides design inspiration and resources to enhance their user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) for your Project and Learning purpose and Also Grow your UI UX career to the next Level.

name: Acceso Design
tagline: Your local design infopoint.
description: Acceso is a curated directory of local design communities. Discover independent design studios, industrial designers, furniture designers, design schools, exhibitions, fairs, design weeks, awards, competitions, manufacturers, workshops, galleries, museums, showrooms, retailers, jobs, and creative opportunities in cities around the world. Each city page includes interactive maps, curated listings, and practical information to help you explore the local design scene.

name: Duply
tagline: What if your AI never had to guess your design again?
description: Real-world design systems documented as ready-to-use DESIGN.md files and agent prompts. Pick a design you love. Copy one file. Your AI agent builds in that visual language.
topics: Design Tools, Artificial Intelligence, Design resources

name: AI Texture
tagline: Generate seamless textures and complete PBR materials
description: AI Texture turns prompts or images into seamless textures and complete PBR material sets. Generate tileable surfaces, build Base Color, Normal, Roughness, Height, and Metalness maps, inspect results in 2D or 3D, and upscale while preserving seamless edges. Built for Blender, Unreal Engine, Unity, Godot, game development, and archviz workflows.
topics: Design Tools, Artificial Intelligence, Design resources

name: Taste Lens
tagline: Decode why any design works, then export the system
description: Taste Lens reads any design — drop an image or paste a URL — and explains why it works across 8 lenses: color, type, composition, texture, style, mood, light, and medium. Then it hands you the parts to build with: copy-paste prompts, a full design system, Figma tokens, shadcn/Tailwind, CSS,ase swatches, and a contrast report. No account, no login.
topics: Design Tools, Artificial Intelligence, Design resources

name: Circle Exhibit
tagline: Plan and explore customizable trade show booth designs
description: Circle Exhibit brings booth planning, design, fabrication, graphics, logistics, and on-site installation into one coordinated service for exhibitors. Instead of managing separate vendors, teams can work with one partner from early layout decisions through show-floor delivery. The service supports customizable rental and custom-built booths, including product demo zones, meeting areas, storage, AV, and venue-specific execution in Las Vegas and major U.S. convention cities.

name: ComiForge
tagline: Turn ideas into publish-ready comics with AI
description: ComiForge is an AI storytelling studio that helps anyone turn ideas into comics, webtoons and visual stories—no drawing skills required. Generate complete comic scenes from text or photos, keep characters consistent, edit layouts, add dialogue, and publish your stories. Built for creators who want to tell stories, not spend hours learning illustration software.

name: WOW Free Fonts
tagline: Discover and preview free fonts for every creative project
description: WOW Free Fonts helps designers, creators and developers discover useful fonts in one simple place. Browse styles, preview typography before downloading and find the right typeface for branding, websites, presentations and other creative projects—without creating an account.

name: TheQuadro
tagline: 233K+ world masterpieces with AI art advisor & smart frames
description: TheQuadro is a digital art platform that brings 233,000+ world masterpieces and 9,000+ artists to your screens and walls. Discover art across 5 dimensions — category, movement, century, subject, and emotion — or chat with our AI art advisor "dro" to understand any masterpiece. Smart cropping adapts artworks to 9 screen ratios for digital frames. AI style transfer turns your photos into Van Gogh paintings. Free to explore in 11 languages.

name: Fudge Design.md
tagline: Open-source catalog of design systems for your AI agent.
description: DESIGN.md guides generated from real website references captured by Fudge.
topics: Design Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Design resources

name: DUI
tagline: Open source UI for AI products built with React
description: DUI is an open-source library of React components, UI blocks, and AI agent skills designed to help developers build modern products faster. Built with Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, and TypeScript, it provides production-ready building blocks for landing pages, dashboards, and AI applications. Starting with the essentials in v0.0.1, DUI will continue to grow with more components, Skills Studio, agent integrations, and developer tools.

name: Parisian Prompt Collection
tagline: 500+ viral AI prompts for Parisian aesthetic
description: 500+ viral prompts for Midjourney, DALL·E & Leonardo - Parisian maximalist aesthetic that sells. Includes: Haussmann apartments, velvet sofas, marble fireplaces, gilt mirrors, Paris fashion, cafe culture & street style. Copy-paste ready. Organized by category. Instant download. Create magazine-cover Parisian interiors & looks in seconds. For designers, creators & AI artists.

name: DFY Dave
tagline: Host

name: visualOS
tagline: The infinite canvas that stores your work as real files
description: An infinite canvas for designers, photographers and artists. Local-first, works fully offline, saves to real files in a folder you own, and stays fast with thousands of items. No account. Free in your browser.
